title: Regulator notification overrun — count of breaches of the statutory window
summary: Count of confirmed-exfil incidents in the window whose regulator notification was emitted after the applicable statutory deadline (NIS2 Art. 23 / DORA Art. 19). A non-zero value is a residual-risk signal: even one overrun is a regulatory-exposure event for the operator.

target.rationale: Zero tolerance: any overrun is a regulatory-exposure event.

measurement.formula: count( incidents where notify_regulator.emitted_at > statutory_deadline(incident.classified_at) ) over window.

external_refs.name: DORA Regulation Article 19 — reporting of major ICT-related incidents
